script.source: String st = doc['status'].size() > 0 ? String.valueOf(doc['status'].value) : '?'; String c = doc.containsKey('client_ip') && doc['client_ip'].size() > 0 ? doc['client_ip'].value : '?'; String ua = doc.containsKey('user_agent') && doc['user_agent'].size() > 0 ? doc['user_agent'].value : '-'; String p = doc['path'].size() > 0 ? doc['path'].value : '-'; String s = doc['container_name'].value + ' ' + st + ' ' + p + ' from ' + c + ' UA=' + ua; s = s.replace('\\', '/').replace('"', "'"); s = /\p{Cntrl}/.matcher(s).replaceAll(' '); return s.length() > 120 ? s.substring(0, 120) + '...' : s;
